==1st Quest==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
! width="4%" | 1
|width="24%"|This is the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 2|second dungeon]].
!width="72%" colspan="3" | ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|Section 1]]''
|-
! 2
|
|width="24%"|Burn the south tree on the eastern most column to discover a hidden shop which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 90 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for 100 rupees, and an ordinary {{im/loz|Item|Heart}} for 10 rupees.
|width="24%"|Touch the right {{im/loz|Enemy|Armos}} to wake him up and move him off the stairwell that he guards.  Enter the stairwell to receive 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|width="24%"|
|-
! 3
|
|
|The shop here sells a {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 160 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Keys}} for 100 rupees, and the {{im/loz|Item|Blue Candle}} for 60 rupees.
|If you have the {{im/loz|Item|Ladder}}, you can collect the {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}} that is positioned on the far dock.
|-
! 4
|
|If you burn down a certain tree that blocks the pathway, you will discover the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 8|eighth dungeon]].
|
|In this shop, you can buy (the ability to use) {{im/loz|Item|Arrows}} for 80 rupees, the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 130 rupees, and a set of 4 {{im/loz|Item|Bombs}} for 20 rupees.
|-
! 5
|Bomb the cliff wall just a little left of center to discover the entrance to a cave where you can play the Money Making Game.
|Bomb this cliff wall just a little left of center and you will reveal a secret door, but if you enter, the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|
|
|}

==2nd Quest==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
! width="4%" | 1
|width="24%"|The entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 3|third dungeon]] is hidden in the lake, and is revealed by the whistle. 
!width="72%" colspan="3" | ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|Section 1]]''
|-
! 2
|
|width="25%"|Burn the south tree on the eastern most column to discover a hidden shop which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 90 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for 100 rupees, and an ordinary {{im/loz|Item|Heart}} for 10 rupees.
|width="25%"|Touch the right {{im/loz|Enemy|Armos}} to wake him up and move him off the stairwell that he guards.  Enter the stairwell to receive 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|width="25%"|
|-
! 3
|
|
|The shop here sells a {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 160 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Keys}} for 100 rupees, and the {{im/loz|Item|Blue Candle}} for 60 rupees.
|If you have the {{im/loz|Item|Ladder}}, you can collect the {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}} that is positioned on the far dock.
|-
! 4
|If you burn down a certain tree on the left side that can only be burned from the right side, you will discover the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 7|seventh dungeon]].
|
|Some notes on the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}} will reveal a staircase that leads to a {{im/loz|Enemy|Red Moblin}} who will give you 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|In this shop, you can buy (the ability to use) {{im/loz|Item|Arrows}} for 80 rupees, the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 130 rupees, and a set of 4 {{im/loz|Item|Bombs}} for 20 rupees.
|-
! 5
|Bomb the cliff wall just a little left of center to discover the entrance to a cave where you can play the Money Making Game.
|Bomb this cliff wall just a little left of center and you will reveal a secret door, but if you enter, the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|
|
|}
